difficulty_rationale: Level 5 (idempotency under half-applied state): four settlement modules still read deprecated res.statusCode/res.body; four already read the canonical res.status/res.data. The SDK exposes both shapes, so the tree type-checks either way. Correct output is either completing the four deprecated sites OR a clean abstention, never a double-apply that corrupts an already-migrated site. A generic HTTP layer with its own statusCode/body is a trap.
notes: Both a correct completion of the four deprecated sites AND a clean abstention are acceptable. Double-apply or corrupting an already-migrated site is the failure. The offline analyze runner records whether the engine abstains; it does not itself apply-then-reapply (idempotency check noted as a partially-measured dimension).
